about: Holiday Nights turns Greenfield Village in Dearborn into a lantern-lit Christmas village on select evenings in December 2026.
Doors open to the public at 6:30 PM and the night ends at 10 PM. Rides are included, with a carousel, Model T rides, horse-drawn wagon rides with live music and free ice skating with skate rental.
Families also see decorated homes and shops, carolers, cooking and artisan demonstrations, and a fireworks finale with a sing-along.
Public tickets run $39 to $48, youth ages 5 to 11 save 25 percent, and children 4 and under are free.
